title: New York Harbor Tours

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Our boat tours around Manhattan offer an incredible and unique way to take in the beauty, size and diversity of Manhattan's architecture and sights. Everything you see on the downtown loop plus a magnificent look at the Empire State, Chrysler, UN buildings, Yankee Stadium, the Cloisters, all of the city's famed bridges and more. Take a boat ride around Manhattan with New York Harbor Tours. It is easily the best way to see all of the sights in a single experience, including the Statue of Liberty, the downtown skyline, Freedom Tower, the Brooklyn Bridge, the East River, the Empire State and Chrysler buildings, the UN Building, Harlem River, Palisades and more.
